verdict.rationale: LobeChat/LobeHub extensively documents MCP integration: a guided wizard to connect local Agents, desktop install/run of MCP connectors, and a marketplace of 100k+ MCP servers to power Agents, plus a probe confirming an 'official MCP server documented at lobehub.com/mcp'. However the docs mostly describe LobeChat as an MCP *client* (installing/discovering third-party MCP servers) rather than clearly detailing LobeChat exposing its own official MCP server endpoint for other agents to connect to. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the official MCP server endpoint's protocol details, and clearer separation of client vs. server MCP roles.
